div.div: The refresh response was lost on the way back (bad network). Because the app sends a stable refreshRequestId, Auth recognises the same request inside a short window and hands back the same new token instead of treating it as theft (idempotency). A revoked token used outside that window is treated as replay: all tokens of that user are revoked and the app signs out.

text.tspan: The refresh response was lost on the way back (bad network). Because the app sends a stable refreshRequestId, Auth recognises the same request inside a short window and hands back the same new token instead of treating it as
theft (idempotency). A revoked token used outside that window is treated as replay: all tokens of that user are revoked and the app signs out.
